entities.summary: Tetrapod footprints which show hominin-like characteristics from the late miocene on the western crete, close to the village of trachilos, west of kissamos, in the chania prefecture. Trachilos footprints is a archaeological site from Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
